umap_2d_fingerprints.scientific_disclaimer: UMAP is a non-linear stochastic manifold learning technique. Low-dimensional Euclidean distances do not reflect exact chemical distances or quantitative sensory perception differences. Embeddings are exploratory representations and do not prove biological olfactory categories.

umap_2d_physicochemical.scientific_disclaimer: Physicochemical UMAP embeds 9 standardized molecular descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA, H-bonding, etc.). Because standard scaling treats all 9 features equally, proximity reflects shared bulk physical properties rather than fine stereochemical or circular substructural similarity.
